result.summary: I've left this case waiting on the landlord's decision about the full-kitchen figures. I also asked the contractor for the cupboards-and-doors-only estimate the landlord wanted, which had never been requested. I moved the CRM stage forward to landlord approval, sent the tenant an update with advice on the sharp edges, and recorded the property and landlord facts. A person needs to settle the 15% commission, cap and VAT question with the contractor before the landlord's total can be confirmed, so I've escalated that at normal priority.
result.situation: Tenant reported peeling cabinet laminate with sharp edges that have caused cuts, and doors that don't close. Two dogs live at the property. The landlord approved only the laminate-repair scope (event 006). The contractor (Kellan Rook, Alderline Joinery) recommends a new kitchen. The landlord asked for two estimates (event 016), but only the full-kitchen one was requested (event 018) and received (event 024): £9,260 plus VAT, including an electrical estimate of £380 that still needs checking. That quote has gone to the landlord (event 025). The commission, cap and VAT basis is unsettled (events 022–023). The CRM stage still showed 'intake'.

judgement.why_this_decision: The next decision belongs to the landlord, who received the figures on 24 Sep (event 025). Nothing is overdue, so waiting with a hold is right. Asking for formal approval now would be premature: the second estimate is missing and the total payable is uncertain because of the commission and VAT issue (events 022–023). That issue is an agency commercial matter, so it goes to a person. The missing second estimate was a gap in the earlier process (event 018 asked only for the full kitchen), and the contractor can fix it, so I asked him directly. The tenant had heard nothing since 9 Sep, has reported injuries, and her offered dates have passed, so she needed an update with safety advice.

alternatives_considered.option: Request formal landlord approval of the full-kitchen quote now
alternatives_considered.why_not: The total payable can't be confirmed while the commission and VAT basis is open, the alternative estimate the landlord asked for is missing, and the landlord already has the figures.

alternatives_considered.option: Move to scheduling under the existing laminate approval
alternatives_considered.why_not: The contractor says that scope isn't workable, and no approval is on record in the CRM.

alternatives_considered.option: Treat as an emergency because of the cuts
alternatives_considered.why_not: This is a sharp-edge hazard the tenant can reduce with tape and by avoiding the edges. It isn't an immediate emergency. I flagged an interim fix for the person to consider.
